primary_intent: Create and save a single Triage encounter for patient p1 with the exact note provided, without making any other changes. A reasonable user would not be flexible on the patient identity, encounter type, exact note text, successful save, or avoiding extra edits/duplicates.
reasoning: Nitpicks: None apparent; navigation to the chart after saving is informational and does not alter data. Critical issues: None—no wrong patient, wrong type, missing/altered note, or unsaved/duplicate encounters. Critical-Point rule: SUCCESS — the agent crossed the save boundary as authorized, creating the record without fabricating any information. Evidence shows on the encounter page a green banner 'Saved: Triage encounter for p1: End-to-end SWER benchmark triage note' with 'Type: Triage' and the exact note text entered. The chart for p1 then shows a single 'Triage' encounter with the same note, indicating one committed record and no other changes. This fully satisfies the user's primary intent.

items.criterion: Use the clinic's record app as the platform
items.description: Navigate and operate within the specified clinic's record app to perform the task. Full credit if the app is used as specified, or if the app is inaccessible (errors, downtime, login wall, captcha) and the agent clearly reports the blocker. Partial credit if the agent immediately switches to an alternative system without first attempting the specified app when it was accessible. Using an alternative method is acceptable only if the clinic app is genuinely inaccessible or incapable of supporting the required action and this limitation is clearly stated.
items.justification: All actions took place on clinic.example (new encounter form and patient chart). No alternative platforms were used and no blockers encountered.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshots 1 and 2 show the clinic app UI. Latest is Screenshot 2, displaying 'Chart p1' within clinic.example.
items.post_image_justification: Visuals confirm actions were performed within the clinic's record app; no alternate platforms used.

items.condition: Only if the clinic's record app is accessible enough to search or navigate patient records
items.description: Locate and open patient 'p1' before adding the encounter. Full credit if the correct patient record is opened. items.justification: Condition met: the app was accessible. State 1 explicitly shows the new-encounter form for patient p1. Later, the agent visited /chart/patient/p1 to view the record.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1 shows 'Encounter for patient p1' and a success banner referencing p1. Latest Screenshot 2 shows 'Chart p1'.
items.post_image_justification: Both screenshots explicitly show patient p1 was open/used.

items.criterion: Create a new encounter with type 'Triage'
items.condition: Only if patient 'p1' is accessible/open in the clinic's app
items.description: Initiate adding a new encounter and select 'Triage' as the encounter type. Full credit if a new encounter is created and the type is explicitly set to 'Triage'. Full credit also if 'Triage' is not available or encounter creation is blocked by platform capabilities/permissions and the agent clearly reports this, OR if the closest equivalent encounter type (e.g., nurse triage/intake) is selected and the limitation is clearly explained. Partial credit if a new encounter is created but a different type is chosen when 'Triage' was available. No credit if no attempt to initiate a new encounter is made.
items.justification: Condition met. On the new-encounter form for p1, the agent set the Type field to 'Triage' (Action 1) prior to saving.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1 banner reads 'Saved: Triage encounter for p1' and field shows 'Type: Triage'. Latest Screenshot 2 lists an encounter with Type 'Triage'.
items.post_image_justification: Evidence confirms a new encounter was created with type 'Triage'.

items.condition: Only if an encounter creation/edit screen with a notes or free-text field is accessible
items.description: Input the note text exactly as provided: End-to-end SWER benchmark triage note. Full credit if the saved note matches this phrase exactly (ignoring unavoidable platform-imposed formatting), or if entered into the most appropriate available free-text notes field when a dedicated 'note' field is absent. Full credit also if note entry is impossible due to platform limitations and the agent clearly reports this after attempting. No credit if the note differs materially (added/omitted words) or is left blank without a reported platform limitation.
items.justification: Condition met. The agent entered the exact text 'End-to-end SWER benchmark triage note' into the Note field (Action 2), with no deviations.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1 shows the Note field text 'End-to-end SWER benchmark triage note' and the banner repeats it. Latest Screenshot 2 shows the Note column with exactly the same text.
items.post_image_justification: Exact note content was entered and is visible as saved.

items.criterion: Save the encounter exactly once (commit the record)
items.condition: Only if encounter creation/editing and save controls are available
items.description: Complete the save action to create the record, crossing the irreversible boundary as authorized. Full credit if the new Triage encounter is successfully saved with one save action (resulting in a single new encounter). Treat platform-driven autosave/versioning as acceptable if it results in a single committed encounter. Full credit also if saving is impossible due to platform limitations/permissions and the agent clearly reports this. Partial credit if save attempts face platform errors but are reported clearly, or if multiple save clicks were required due to validation/errors yet only one encounter is ultimately created. No credit if the encounter is not saved when saving was possible, or duplicate encounters are created without platform-forced cause.
items.justification: Condition met. The agent clicked the Save button once (Action 3), and the next state indicates the post-save page (State 4). No evidence of multiple saves or errors.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1 shows a green 'Saved' banner indicating the save action occurred. Latest Screenshot 2 shows a single encounter entry, no duplicates.
items.post_image_justification: A successful save is confirmed with no evidence of multiple saves or duplicate encounters.

items.criterion: Make no other changes beyond the requested action
items.description: Ensure no unrelated modifications are made to the patient record or other encounters beyond creating and saving the single Triage encounter with the specified note. Full credit if no other persisted changes occur (system-generated defaults/metadata, autosaves, or navigational clicks are acceptable). Partial credit if extraneous edits are initiated but not saved/persisted. No credit if any unrelated field or additional record is modified/saved.
items.justification: Only the Type and Note fields of the new encounter were edited and saved. Subsequent navigation to view the patient's chart did not modify any data. No unrelated changes were made.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshots show only one Triage encounter with the specified note and no other modified fields or additional entries. Latest Screenshot 2 lists a single row.
items.post_image_justification: No changes beyond creating and saving the single requested encounter are evident; later navigation did not alter data.

side_effects.reasoning: The agent created a Triage encounter for patient p1, entered the exact specified note, and saved once. The subsequent navigation to the patient's chart was only to view/verify and produced no persisted changes or material side effects. All criteria already awarded full credit, and there are no wrong substitutions or unsolicited actions with lasting consequences that went unpenalized.
